Punjabi Film 'Birds in the Dark' Wins Audience Award at Busan

The Punjabi film 'Birds in the Dark' has won the Songwon Vision Audience Award at the Busan Film Festival in South Korea. The film, directed by Shashank Walia, received this recognition at the festival.
